# XRAY Logo Inline Code

Copy-paste ready SVG code and base64 data URIs for all logo variants. Use these to embed logos directly into HTML, CSS, or PDFs. For email, use the PNG wordmarks in `../assets/` (`wordmark-dark.png` on light backgrounds, `wordmark-light.png` on Gray 900). Many major email clients do not render SVG at all, base64 or not.

---

## Usage Examples

### HTML inline SVG (most common)
```html
<header style="background: floralwhite; padding: 24px 16px;">
  <!-- Paste the Wordmark Dark SVG code directly here -->
  <svg width="323" height="96" viewBox="0 0 323 96" ...>...</svg>
</header>
```

### HTML img tag with base64
```html
<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB3aWR0aD0i..." alt="XRAY" style="height: 40px;" />
```

### CSS background-image
```css
.xray-logo {
  background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB3aWR0aD0i...');
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain;
}
```

### ReportLab PDF (convert SVG to PNG first)
```python
# SVGs can't be directly embedded in ReportLab; use svglib or cairosvg
from svglib.svglib import svg2rlg
from reportlab.graphics import renderPDF

drawing = svg2rlg('wordmark-dark.svg')
renderPDF.draw(drawing, canvas, x, y)
```

### Email HTML (use a PNG, not SVG)

SVG does not render in many major email clients, including when it is a base64 data URI. Attach or host the PNG and point the image at that file.

- Light background: `../assets/wordmark-dark.png` (fill `#0E1C2D`)
- Gray 900 header: `../assets/wordmark-light.png` (fill `#FFFAF0`, not pure white)

```html
<img src="https://example.com/wordmark-light.png" alt="XRAY" width="135" height="40" />
```
